proposal.hypothesis: Correct the inverse-distance cube directly using the squared relative error of rsqrtf, rather than refining the reciprocal distance and then cubing it. The first-order cube correction should have only a second-order residual when the rsqrt estimate is close, while reducing dependent multiplies. The controller must validate float32 tolerance and measure the official geometric-mean objective.

retained: Form the unrefined inverse-distance cube as invDistSq * invDist.
Compute q - 1 with fmaf(distSq, invDistSq, -1.0f) and apply the first-order cube correction with fmaf(-1.5f, squareError, 1.0f).
Retain the zero-reciprocal guard so infinite squared distances do not create an infinity-times-zero NaN during correction.
